# Phaser 4.2.1 vendor copy

This directory contains the official minified ESM build from the Phaser
`v4.2.1` release tag. The file is copied byte-for-byte and verified during
every build against the SHA-256 recorded in `manifest.json`.

The project vendors this browser runtime so the creator preview is a fully
static artifact. It does not load Phaser from a CDN, npm registry, GitHub, or
another network source at runtime.

Source: <https://github.com/phaserjs/phaser/releases/tag/v4.2.1>
